dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It was quite a shock when I first left the Conch Gang to strike out on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Leaving such a lively collective to live all alone, it was hard not to feel a little lonely... Thankfully, now I have Lumi, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: By the way, don't tell anyone in the Conch Gang I said that. I don't want them knowing how uncertain their old boss was.
